bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Interfaith Action.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+EMERGENCY FAMILY SHELTERS; ACQUISITION AND REHABILITATION. +]

[+$....... is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Interfaith Action for the acquisition and rehabilitation of space to expand shelter capacity and improve services for families experiencing homelessness. Grant proceeds may be used for child-friendly spaces, trauma-informed design, and on-site support services. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Interfaith Action.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. EMERGENCY FAMILY SHELTERS; ACQUISITION AND REHABILITATION.

$....... is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Interfaith Action for the acquisition and rehabilitation of space to expand shelter capacity and improve services for families experiencing homelessness. Grant proceeds may be used for child-friendly spaces, trauma-informed design, and on-site support services. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned.
additions: EMERGENCY FAMILY SHELTERS; ACQUISITION AND REHABILITATION.
